name: Cheeks Produce
description: A small farm in Taylorsville, KY, Cheeks Produce grows Squash, Corn, Tomatoes, Peppers, and Eggplant. The farm is busiest in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Oct in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
